The infimum of $B$ is the {{field-1}} of $B,$ and the supremum is the {{field-2}} of $B.$

Since $B$ is {{field-3}}, we have $inf(B)$ {{field-4}}.

Since $B$ is {{field-5}}, we have $sup(B)$ {{field-6}}.

The infimum of B is the

smallest upper bound
of B, and the supremum is the
smallest upper bound
smallest upper bound
greatest lower bound
smallest lower bound
greatest upper bound
of B.

Since B is
unbounded below
unbounded below
bounded above
unbounded above
bounded below
, we have inf(B)
=−∞
=−∞
=+∞
=π
=0

bounded above
